name: readoutto-me
description: Web application to read text out online

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && deno task build:html && deno task build:css && deno task build:js && deno task build:public
scripts.build:html: deno run -A npm:html-minifier --keep-closing-slash  --collapse-whitespace --collapse-boolean-attributes --conservative-collapse --remove-comments --output-dir dist/ --input-dir web/ --file-ext html
scripts.build:css: deno run -A npm:postcss-cli web/**/*.css --dir dist/ --use autoprefixer --use cssnano --no-map

author: gabriel
